notes.title: Magic Love Date is exhibiting at WePlay Shanghai!
notes.content:
Greetings, Presiding Officers!I'm your Ai, and I'm happy to announce that we'll be meeting early!

Tomorrow! Ai-chan will be bringing the demo of Magic Love Bound with her to meet with the Inquisitors.

Not only that, Ai will be waiting for you at the show with a gift (a beautiful bar and a stand-up sign), so don't let Ai wait too long.
